description: One regulation: what it is, its jurisdiction and scope, a link to the law itself, and reaches[] — the country, region and industry cohorts this regime binds. Use reaches[] to go straight to the affected members with find_providers.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

slug.description: Regulation slug, as find_regulations returns it, e.g. "21-cfr-part-11".

name: get_regulation
